svg.title: The Cone of the P3 Basis and Its Graphs
svg.desc: The cone a≥0, 0≤b≤3a. Extreme rays: the unit path P3 with coordinates (1,3), and edge 1–3 with isolated vertex 2 at (2,0). The four marked points represent all simple graphs in the fixed basis. The complete graph K3 is at (3,3).

cc:Work.dc:description: The cone a≥0, 0≤b≤3a. Extreme rays: the unit path P3 with coordinates (1,3), and edge 1–3 with isolated vertex 2 at (2,0). The four marked points represent all simple graphs in the fixed basis. The complete graph K3 is at (3,3).
